reciprocityLaw: Every trace names at least one existing case; every case and mutation control belongs to at least one trace; a case lists a trace id exactly when that trace lists the case id; every evidence owner is a named future test file for E1/build (or this package's own static test for authority-integrity).

traces.requirement: SMF headers, chunk lengths, variable-length quantities, running status, and byte order are deterministic and parse independently as valid format-1 files.
Ascending ticks; at an equal tick meta precedes channel, note-offs precede note-ons, and equal kinds order by ascending note number.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 16.3 (note-off ordering before note-on at equal ticks)

traces.requirement: Integer tempo encodes as nearest microseconds per quarter with the exact rational rounding error reported; 20 and 400 are inclusive bounds.
Time-signature meta carries beatsPerBar, log2(beatUnit), 24, 8; non-power-of-two units refuse.
traces.parentSource: SMF 1.0 time-signature meta and the domain meter shape

traces.requirement: Markers bind to plan events, sort by tick then section-before-chord then bound-event ordinal, refuse unbound or duplicate bindings, and carry text verbatim.
traces.parentSource: REBUILD_PLAN 16.3 (conductor track markers; symbols retained in marker text)

traces.requirement: Enharmonic spelling, absent chord annotations, and unrepresentable loop ranges are reported as explicit losses, never silently dropped.
traces.parentSource: E1 required implementation (explicit spelling/annotation losses) and REBUILD_PLAN 16.3

traces.requirement: Gate ticks are exact: one-tick durations keep their full gate, gates below one tick or above the duration refuse.
traces.parentSource: P0 articulation policy and E1 exact-gate requirement

traces.requirement: The report states writer pins, tempo encoding with bounded error, counts, byte length, total ticks, filename, and losses exactly.
traces.parentSource: E1 required implementation (report nearest-microsecond conversion and losses)

traces.requirement: Every reachable refusal code fires from its dedicated near-miss with the documented pointer under the frozen precedence.
traces.parentSource: E1 bead (malformed/near-miss cases) and the section-2 precedence

traces.requirement: Text, marker, and VLQ bounds hold exactly at their edges: acceptance at each cap, refusal one past it.
traces.parentSource: E1 bead (limit cases) and the module limits

traces.requirement: Filenames derive deterministically from the document id under the frozen sanitize-truncate law; object URLs are never created in the export layer.
A request whose document id does not match the plan refuses rather than exporting stale state.
The fixture package itself is mutation-sensitive: manifest constants match the frozen module, byte goldens cannot drift, trace reciprocity holds, and provenance flags cannot flip silently.
traces.parentSource: E1 bead exit criteria (mutation-sensitive contract, independent authorship)
